trigger_or_action.reason: Any unprivileged address calling rebalanceFunds when balance exceeds target is a concrete trigger.

direct_effect.reason: Excess DLF pushed to custodian, available balance reduced to target, redemptions forced to custodian path.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Documented owner-only access control vs actual permissionless call provides authorization relation; fast-access guarantee vs forced custodian path provides expected-vs-actual relation.

summary: Report identifies the vulnerable function, permissionless trigger, concrete buffer-drain effect, and both authorization and fast-access guarantee violations, sufficient to attempt P/I/V formalization.
